title: Denoised but Not Improved: What EEG Denoising Does to a Downstream Task
abstract: arXiv:2611.29256v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scalp electroencephalography (EEG) is routinely denoised before it reaches a downstream model, and the denoising literature scores a method by how closely its output matches a clean reference waveform. That reference does not exist for real scalp recordings: it is synthesized by adding artifact templates to signals merely presumed clean, and even an exact separation would return cortical activity blurred by volume conduction rather than the activity itself. Fidelity to it is therefore an unvalidatable objective, and whether it predicts any downstream benefit has gone largely unexamined. We report an audit that examines it. Holding a seizure-detection pipeline fixed and varying only the preprocessing stage, we find that five standard denoising methods, spanning analytic, cross-channel and supervised deep families, all fail to improve on the unprocessed signal, and most degrade it. translated_title: 去噪却未获改善：EEG去噪对下游任务的影响
translated_abstract: 头皮脑电图（EEG）在进入下游模型之前通常都会进行去噪处理，而去噪文献以方法输出与干净参考波形的接近程度来评价方法优劣。然而，对于真实的头皮记录而言，这种参考波形并不存在：它是通过将伪迹模板添加到仅被假定为干净的信号上合成而来的，而且即使能够实现完全精确的分离，得到的也只会是被容积传导效应模糊化的皮层活动，而非活动本身。因此，对这种参考波形的保真度是一个无法验证的目标，而它是否能带来任何下游收益在很大程度上未被检验过。我们报告了一项对此进行审查的审计研究。在保持癫痫检测流程不变、仅改变预处理阶段的情况下，我们发现五种标准去噪方法——涵盖解析类、跨通道类和有监督深度学习类方法——均未能优于未经处理的信号，且大多数方法反而使其性能下降。为了阐明这样的预处理阶段应当做什么，我们形式化了……
tldr: 本研究通过固定癫痫检测流程、仅更换预处理阶段的审计实验，发现涵盖解析、跨通道和有监督深度学习的五种主流EEG去噪方法均无法改善甚至恶化下游任务性能，并指出以“干净参考波形”为保真度目标的去噪评价体系本身是无法验证的无效目标。
en_tdlr: By auditing a fixed seizure-detection pipeline while varying only the preprocessing stage, this study shows that five standard EEG denoising methods—spanning analytic, cross-channel, and supervised deep approaches—all fail to improve and mostly degrade downstream performance, revealing that fidelity to a "clean reference waveform" is an unvalidatable objective that predicts no downstream benefit.
